title: Concept: Workflow grants write permissions to every scope in gha — review required
description: In gha, the workflow token is granted every write scope. GitHub Actions exposes that token to every step, including third-party actions, so the effective privilege of the entire pipeline is the maximum scope. Narrow read defaults exist to keep a compromised dependency from pushing to the default branch.
applicability: gha repositories that run automation on pull requests.
risk: Repository or package takeover through a compromised step; MEDIUM severity.
